WITH prices AS (
         SELECT daily_market_quote.security_id,
            daily_market_quote.trade_date,
            (COALESCE(daily_market_quote.adjusted_close, daily_market_quote.close_price))::double precision AS price,
            lag((COALESCE(daily_market_quote.adjusted_close, daily_market_quote.close_price))::double precision) OVER (PARTITION BY daily_market_quote.security_id ORDER BY daily_market_quote.trade_date) AS previous_price
           FROM daily_market_quote
        ), returns AS (
         SELECT prices.security_id,
            prices.trade_date,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((prices.previous_price > (0)::double precision) AND (prices.price > (0)::double precision)) THEN ((prices.price / prices.previous_price) - (1.0)::double precision)
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS daily_return
           FROM prices
        ), rolling AS (
         SELECT returns.security_id,
            returns.trade_date,
            returns.daily_return,
            stddev_samp(returns.daily_return) OVER (PARTITION BY returns.security_id ORDER BY returns.trade_date ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sample_volatility,
            count(returns.daily_return) OVER (PARTITION BY returns.security_id ORDER BY returns.trade_date ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS return_observations_30d
           FROM returns
        )
 SELECT security_id,
    trade_date,
    daily_return,
        CASE
            WHEN (return_observations_30d = 30) THEN sample_volatility
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END AS rolling_volatility_30d,
    return_observations_30d
   FROM rolling;
